title: State of Bihar v. Kameshwar Singh

content.caseIdentity: State of Bihar v. Kameshwar Singh, AIR 1952 SC 252
content.holding: Confiscating arrears of rent and returning 50% as compensation under Entry 42 List III was struck down as colourable legislation and a fraud on constitutional power.
content.relevance: Classic Supreme Court instance of striking down colourable legislation.
